units.source_text: 宇治方面虽已得到亲王今天要来的通知，

en.t: Although word had already reached Uji that the prince would come today,

units.source_text: 但念如此大雪，未必成行，大家不以为意。

en.t: everyone thought that with such heavy snow he would probably not make the journey, and paid little attention to it.

units.source_text: 岂知到了夜深，果然有人来向右近通报了。

en.t: But late that night, as it happened, someone came to inform Ukon.

units.source_text: 浮舟闻知，对亲王的诚意也很感动。

en.t: When Ukifune heard this, she too was deeply moved by the prince's sincerity.

units.source_text: 右近近来常常忧虑这个局面如何了结，心中非常痛苦。

en.t: Lately Ukon had often worried about how this situation would end, and she was suffering greatly in her heart.

units.source_text: 然而今宵看见亲王雪夜入山，一切顾虑都忘记了。

en.t: Yet tonight, seeing the prince enter the mountains on a snowy night, she forgot all her misgivings.

units.source_text: 事已如此，总不好劝他回去，

en.t: Since things had come to this, she could hardly urge him to go back,

units.source_text: 她就找一个同自己一样为浮舟所亲信而知情达理的侍女，

en.t: so she sought out a maid who, like herself, was trusted by Ukifune and understood what was proper,

units.source_text: 即名叫侍从的，同她商量：“这件事非常困难！

en.t: a woman named Jiju, and consulted with her, saying, This matter is terribly difficult!

units.source_text: 但愿你和我同心协力，严守秘密。”

en.t: Please join your heart and strength with mine, and keep the secret strictly.

units.source_text: 两人就设法引导匂亲王入内。

en.t: The two of them then found a way to guide Prince Niou inside.

units.source_text: 他那在路上沾湿了的衣服，香气四溢，使得两人担心。

en.t: His clothes, damp from the road, gave off fragrance everywhere, making the two women anxious.

units.source_text: 全靠这香气与薰大将的相似，可以马虎过去。

en.t: Only because the scent resembled Captain Kaoru's could they somehow let it pass.
